name: Executive Dashboard Publisher
description: Syncs aggregate data and publishes dashboards to Tableau or PowerBI workspaces.

parameters.name: arguments
parameters.description: JSON string of parameters defined in contracts.py. For 'generate_pdf_report': report_name, database_url, planner-authored latex_content (required, full document), and planner-authored 'chart_code' (list of Python seaborn/matplotlib snippets; each runs with pd/np/plt/sns/db_url/output_dir/load_df(sql) bound and saves PNGs into output_dir, referenced from the LaTeX via \includegraphics). No auto-report fallback. For 'publish_report': report_name, datasource_name. For 'trigger_refresh': dataset_id. For 'get_share_link': report_id.
